disclaimer: Domain knowledge, not legal advice. Confirm applicability per jurisdiction with a qualified reviewer.

items.name: PCI DSS
items.scope: Any restaurant storing, processing, or transmitting card payment data (POS, online ordering, gift cards).
items.notes: Compliance is typically achieved via a PCI-validated payment gateway/terminal (scope reduction), not by building card handling in-house.

items.name: EU Regulation 1169/2011 (food information to consumers)
items.scope: Mandatory allergen disclosure for the 14 EU-listed allergens on menus and pre-packed food sold in the EU.
items.notes: Exact disclosure format (menu text, allergen matrix, verbal-on-request) varies by EU member state implementation.

items.name: US FDA menu labeling (21 CFR 101.11)
items.jurisdiction: United States (federal; applies to chains with 20+ locations)
items.scope: Calorie disclosure on menus/menu boards and availability of additional nutrition information on request.
items.notes: Threshold and scope (20+ locations under a common name) mean many independent restaurants are exempt; verify applicability per operator.

items.name: Tip pooling and labour/wage rules
items.jurisdiction: varies by country/state (e.g. US: FLSA tip credit rules vary by state)
items.scope: Rules governing tip pooling, tip credits against minimum wage, and service-charge distribution.
items.notes: Illustrative only — one example (US FLSA) is cited; tip/labour law differs sharply by jurisdiction and must be reviewed per deployment, never assumed compliant from this entry.
